english.note: This is the all-purpose Hong Kong term for a game played electronically on a computer or console.
Use this when you specifically mean a video or computer game rather than a game in general.

examples.english: I bought a new video game yesterday, so I can play it when I get home tonight.
examples.traditional: 我尋日買咗隻新電子遊戲，今晚返屋企就可以玩喇。
